title_sq: APARTAMENT 2+1 PER SHITJE LIQENI I THATE
description_sq:
Ofrohet apartament 2+1 per shitje te rruga Hamdi Garunja, liqeni thate.
Apartamenti ka nje nje siperfaqe prej 97m2 i organizuar ne 2 dhoma gjumi nje tualet me dritare dhe soxhorno me kuzhine te vecuar dhe dy ballkone.
Apartamenti eshte plot drite dhe diell dhe ka pamje nga liqeni.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 3 te nje pallati te ri me ashensor dhe te miradministruar me vetem 2 hyrje ne kat.
Apartamenti eshte investuar dhe mobiluar se fundmi.
Prona eshte pajisur me dokument te rregullt hipotekor
Per me shume informacione ose nje shoqerim ne prone na kontaktoni.
description_en: A 2+1 apartment is offered for sale on Hamdi Garunja Street, dry lake. The apartment has a surface area of ​​97m2, organized into 2 bedrooms, a bathroom with window and a living room with a separate kitchen and two balconies. The apartment is full of light and sun and has a view of the lake. The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a new building with an elevator and well managed with only 2 entrances to the floor. The apartment has been recently invested and furnished. The property is equipped with a regular mortgage document. For more information or a tour of the property, contact us.
